name: context-compaction
description: Mid-flow context compression. Two analyses accumulate a lot of context; a context-compactor distills them into one tight decision brief; the final decision reads ONLY the brief (the raw analyses are deliberately withheld via prompt scoping). The pattern that keeps long orchestrations from drowning later agents in stale context — capture with `as`, compact, then scope the downstream prompt to the digest.

phases.name: analyze-usage
phases.prompt:
Analyze, in depth, the usage/adoption angle of the following. Be thorough and detailed.

${input}

phases.name: analyze-risk
phases.description: Second angle — also verbose, so context accumulates.
phases.prompt:
Analyze, in depth, the risk / edge-case angle of the following. Be thorough and detailed.

${input}

phases.name: compact
phases.description: Distill both analyses into a tight, decision-ready brief — keep the load-bearing facts, drop the verbosity.

phases.name: decide
phases.description: Decide from the BRIEF ALONE — the raw analyses are intentionally NOT in this prompt, keeping the decider's context tight and focused (the whole point of compaction).
